QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Enable the deviceID + AES-256-GCM encrypted MAVLink link. When enabled, incoming plaintext frames are dropped; outgoing frames are encrypted once the link is Active (task-specific).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable encrypted link

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoGcsServerUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Base URL of the gcs_server that provides device keys (e.g. https://uav.example.com).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: gcs_server URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoAuthToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Bearer token used to authenticate with gcs_server when fetching device keys.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Auth token

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoGcsDeviceID
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This ground station's own 32-bit deviceID, written into the frame header when sending encrypted frames.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GCS deviceID

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoKeySource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Where QGC obtains device communication keys. 0 = local key file (mavlink_key.bin in AppConfigLocation, for local link bring-up); 1 = gcs_server / database (HTTPS fetch).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Key source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: cryptoLocalKeyDeviceID
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Target deviceID the local key file binds to, used when cryptoKeySource = 0 (local key file). Should match the drone's MAV_DEVICE_ID.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Local key deviceID
